browser: Chromium 152.0.7977.130 (Claude desktop app browser pane), Windows 11
consent: Optional analytics rejected in the cookie banner before the test.
method: Two synthetic one-page PDFs were created in the page, each containing the text TEKIVEX-PRIVACY-CHECK-7731.
Before merging, fetch, XMLHttpRequest, navigator.sendBeacon and WebSocket were wrapped to record every outgoing request and its body.
The automatic download was intercepted so nothing was written to disk; the merged file stayed a blob: URL in the page.
The browser's own network log for the tab was read afterwards, to catch requests the page-level wrappers could miss.

requestsStartedByPressingMerge.what: the PDF library (pdf-lib), downloaded the first time a file is processed

notes: Asset file names contain build hashes and change with each deployment. The test was not repeated with analytics accepted.
